_comment: QBazaar Cloudflare rules (OPS-18.18, OPS-18.9), reviewed source of truth. One key per Rulesets API phase; each array is the `rules` body of PUT /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/phases/{phase}/entrypoint. That PUT REPLACES every rule in the phase, so back up the current phase first (deploy/cloudflare/README.md). The dashboard steps in the README produce the same rules. Hosts assume API_HOST=api.qbazaar.qa, WEB_HOST=qbazaar.qa and the R2 custom domain cdn.qbazaar.qa.

http_request_firewall_custom.description: Block probes for files this stack never serves (PHP outside Laravel's front controller, dotfiles, vendor, WordPress)
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: (http.host in {"qbazaar.qa" "www.qbazaar.qa" "api.qbazaar.qa"} and ((ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".php") and http.request.uri.path ne "/index.php") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.env") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.git") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/vendor/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/xmlrpc")))

http_request_firewall_custom.description: Only GET and HEAD reach the media host
Optional: challenge the admin panel from outside the expected countries (log first; add your own country codes)
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: (http.host eq "api.qbazaar.qa" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") and not ip.src.country in {"QA"})

http_ratelimit.description: Sign-in, sign-up and code endpoints: 20 POSTs per 10 s per IP (each OTP send costs an SMS)
http_ratelimit.expression: (http.host eq "api.qbazaar.qa" and http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/auth/"))

http_ratelimit.description: Pro plan and up: search and image uploads, 100 requests per 60 s per IP
http_ratelimit.expression: (http.host eq "api.qbazaar.qa" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/search") or (http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/ads/") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/images"))))

http_request_cache_settings.description: cdn.: R2 media, cached at the edge; objects set their own Cache-Control (conversions: 1 year, immutable)
Next.js build assets: content-hashed, cached a year
API answers vary by token and Accept-Language, which the edge ignores: never cache them, except /storage files
